description: Source code for purchase order and purchase order line management in an Odoo module, including class definitions, fields, and methods for order processing.

classes.name: purchase_order_line
classes.description: Model extending 'purchase.order.line' with additional fields and methods for order line status and invoicing.

classes.name: purchase_order
classes.description: Model extending 'purchase.order' with methods for invoice creation and order confirmation.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Overrides copy_data to reset certain fields when duplicating an order line.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the purchase order line, setting its status to 'confirmed'.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoices for the purchase order and marks order lines as invoiced.

methods.name: wkf_confirm_order
methods.description: Confirms the purchase order and its draft order lines.
